name: site-ethossoftware
description: Site institucional da Ethos Software — Astro 6 SSG + React 19 Islands + Vercel adapter.

scripts.lint: biome lint src scripts astro.config.mjs vitest.config.ts
scripts.format: biome format --write src scripts astro.config.mjs vitest.config.ts
scripts.validate: pnpm check && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.perf:lh: cross-env LH_PORT=4321 LH_ROUTES=home,servicos,portfolio,404 LH_OUT_PREFIX=lighthouse-astro node scripts/run-lighthouse-mobile.cjs
scripts.perf:baseline: cross-env LH_PORT=4321 LH_ROUTES=home,servicos,portfolio,404 LH_OUT_DIR=lighthouse-baselines LH_OUT_PREFIX=baseline-astro node scripts/run-lighthouse-mobile.cjs
scripts.perf:compare:cross: cross-env LH_FINAL_DIR=lighthouse-baselines LH_BASELINE_PREFIX=baseline LH_FINAL_PREFIX=baseline-astro LH_ROUTES=home,servicos,portfolio node scripts/compare-lighthouse.cjs
